intro.text:
Hi! I'm Viviana! ♡


I love creating cute, happy little things that bring a bit of joy into everyday life! I believe that surrounding ourselves with positivity and little moments of happiness can make a difference. The world can be a pretty messy place sometimes, and I think we all need little escapes from it now and then. I hope my art can bring a little bit of that happiness to others!


After working for a few years as a Data Scientist and AI Engineer, I realised I wanted to dedicate my time to something that felt closer to my heart. So, in the middle of 2025, I took a leap of faith, left my full-time job and decided to pursue art!


I've always loved drawing and exploring different creative hobbies, but I eventually found my passion in clay sculpting and digital art. I'm also always curious to learn new things, and I've also been exploring 3D modelling!


Something very important to me is that all my creations are made by me, without generative AI. I value the creativity, individuality and little personal touches that go into making each piece. That's what makes art so special to me!


And that's how Vii Arts & Crafts was born! I'm now running my own little art business, and I couldn't be happier doing what I love. I also created my own characters, The Little Buddies, and I hope someday many people will love them as much as I do!


Thank you for being here and supporting my creative adventure. It means a lot! ♡

contact.text: I'm currently accepting custom commissions if they fit in my art style! ✨ whether you'd like to bring a personal idea to reality or have a piece featured in my collection. Feel free to reach out by email anytime.
